brute_force.meaning: Many failed logins from one IP in a short window, typically guessing passwords for one account.
actions: Block the source IP at the firewall
Disable SSH password login and use keys
Check whether any login from this IP succeeded

user_enumeration.meaning: One IP tried many different usernames, probing which accounts exist.
actions: Review which usernames exist on the server
Watch for follow-up password attacks from the same IP

success_after_failures.meaning: A login succeeded from an IP that had just failed many times; the account may be compromised.
actions: Treat the account as compromised: reset its password and revoke sessions
Review commands and files touched after the login
Check other accounts for logins from this IP

isolation_forest.meaning: The activity is statistically unusual compared with other windows, but no specific rule matched.
actions: Manually review the raw log lines for this IP and window
Compare with the IP's behaviour in other windows
